title: 02. Tool Calling & MCP: Tool Registry & Dynamic Loading
summary: Tool Registry & Dynamic Loading: explanations and runnable examples.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              TOOL REGISTRY — THE CENTRAL HUB                    │
│                                                                 │
│  A Tool Registry is a CATALOG of all available tools.           │
│  It handles: registration, discovery, execution, validation.    │
│                                                                 │
│  WITHOUT REGISTRY:              WITH REGISTRY:                  │
│  ─────────────────────────      ───────────────────────────     │
│  Tools scattered everywhere     All tools in one place          │
│  Hard to add new tools          Add with @register decorator    │
│  No validation                  Auto-validates inputs/outputs   │
│  Duplicate implementations      One canonical implementation    │
│  Hard to test                   Easy to mock/test               │
│                                                                 │
│  HOW IT WORKS:                                                  │
│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│  │  @registry.register(                                   │    │
│  │      name="search_web",                                │    │
│  │      description="Search for current info",            │    │
│  │      category="information",                           │    │
│  │  )                                                     │    │
│  │  def search_web(query: str, max_results: int=5):       │    │
│  │      ...                                               │    │
│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│                     ↓ Registry stores:                          │
│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│  │  {                                                     │    │
│  │    "search_web": {                                     │    │
│  │      "function":    <function search_web>,             │    │
│  │      "schema":      {JSON schema for OpenAI},          │    │
│  │      "category":    "information",                     │    │
│  │      "description": "Search for current info",         │    │
│  │    }                                                   │    │
│  │  }                                                     │    │
│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│                                                                 │
│  DYNAMIC LOADING:                                               │
│  Agent can load DIFFERENT tools for different tasks:            │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  Research task → load [search, wikipedia, summarizer]   │   │
│  │  Coding task   → load [executor, linter, file_reader]   │   │
│  │  Data task     → load [csv_reader, analyzer, plotter]   │   │
│  │  Why: Right tools for the job. No bloat.                │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
